response.courseDescription: 202 Calculus for Business and Economics Differential calculus of the polynomial, exponential, and logarithmic functions; focus on unconstrained and constrained optimization, single and partial differentiation. By department consent, credit may be allowed for two of MATH 140, 171, or 202.
response.coursePrerequisites: MATH 106 with a C or better, MATH 201 with a C or better, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 80%.  Enrollment not allowed if credit already earned for MATH 140,171 or DATA 121 except by department consent.
